caption: The drawing shows a single object centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object appears to be a round, cylindrical container with a domed top. It is depicted in shades of brown, giving it a metallic or earthenware appearance. The top of the container features a small knob or handle, as well as an elongated slot, suggesting it could be a coin bank. Shading and highlights are used to portray the curvature and reflective quality of the surface, with lighter areas on the top indicating a light source coming from the upper left. The object's shadow is faint and directly below it. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "Lee Brown."
title: Pottery Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
